To determine whether the protein encoded by *SKA1* or *ASB7* is heavier, we can examine their canonical human protein products in the UniProt database:

- **SKA1** encodes the **SKA complex subunit 1** (UniProt: [Q96BD8](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q96BD8)):
  - Length: 255 amino acids
  - Molecular mass: **29.484 kDa** (29,484 Da)
  - Isoform 2: 209 amino acids, 24.390 kDa

- **ASB7** encodes the **Ankyrin repeat and SOCS box protein 7** (UniProt: [Q9H672](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9H672)):
  - Length: 318 amino acids
  - Molecular mass: **36.011 kDa** (36,011 Da)
  - Isoform 2: 274 amino acids, 30.713 kDa

Comparing both the canonical proteins and their respective isoforms, the protein encoded by **ASB7** is heavier than the protein encoded by **SKA1**.
